card.share_text: Ikhwalithi yomoya ku-{{city}}: {{pm25}} µg/m³ ({{category}}) nge-Mframapa AI
advice.moderate: Lizinga lemkhatsini. Bantfu labeva kufanele banciphe sikhatsi.
advice.sensitive: Akukafaneli emacembu leva. Faka sifonyo uma kudzingeka.
insight.good: Izimo zomoya ezihlanzekile ngenxa yokuhlakazeka kahle komoya. Iphephile kuyo yonke imisebenzi.
insight.moderate: Ukwakheka kwezinhlayiyana ezincane. Izimo zamukelekile kubantu abaningi.
insight.sensitive: Izinhlayiya eziphakeme ezingaba khona ezikhiqizweni zasendaweni. Amaqembu azwelayo kufanele athathe izinyathelo zokuphepha.
insight.unhealthy: Ukuzinza okuphezulu kwe-particle kuphawuliwe. Iphakamisa imithombo yendawo evuthayo.
insight.hazardous: Ikhwalithi yomoya eyingozi. Hlala endlini futhi usebenzise ukuhlunga komoya uma kungenzeka.
about.title: Mayelana ne-Mframapa AI
about.overview.desc: I-Mframapa AI ikwebelela i-PM2.5 lilanga nelilanga etiveni letingu-54 tase-Afrika.
about.overview.problem_desc: Emadolobha lamanyenti ase-Afrika awona tikhali tekwebelela umoya. Sigcwalisa lesi sikhala.
about.how.step1.title: Ti-Satellite njengetisenso
about.how.step1.desc: Kusebentisa idatha ye-ESA Sentinel-5P ne-NASA MERRA-2.
about.how.step2.title: Kulungisa Kwemhlaba
about.how.step2.desc: Imodeli ifundziswe etiteshini letingu-398 etiveni letingu-29.
about.how.step3.title: Kucabanga Kwelikontinent
about.how.step3.desc: Imodeli ye-XGBoost icabanga i-PM2.5 kunoma indzawo yase-Afrika.
about.limit.gap_desc: Kudlula kwe-satellite lilanga nelilanga kungaphutwa kuphakama kwesikhashana.

screen.trust.title: Kwetsemba neKuvuleka
screen.trust.intro: We show estimates from satellites and weather models so you can decide when to go outside. Here is what goes into those estimates.
screen.trust.calc_body: Silinganisa kutsi kungcola kangakanani elutfulini kanye nentfutfu emoyeni lapho ukhona, bese sikugucula sikwente indlela lula yetincumo langatentako.
screen.trust.source_era5: Hourly weather from Europe's climate reanalysis (wind, humidity, temperature).
screen.trust.source_s5p: Satellite gas columns that help spot pollution plumes.
screen.trust.source_modis: Satellite aerosol optical depth for dust and smoke.
screen.trust.source_openmeteo: Fast weather fallback when primary feeds are slow or offline.
screen.trust.source_worldpop: Population density used to classify urban vs rural models.
screen.trust.source_openaq: Ground monitor readings when stations report nearby.
screen.trust.disclaim_body: Mframapa iniketa tilinganiso, hhayi tikali tekukala tincuma. Kute siphephetsi emgwacweni wakho, ngako setjentiswa njengesetfulo. Ngetincumo tebudokotela nome tetemtsetfo, sebentisa kuhlolwa kwahulumende.
